Next.js TypeScript App Router: `src/app`, `src/app/api/*`; UI `src/components`, hooks `src/hooks`, utils `src/lib`; assets `public/`, scripts `scripts/` (`scripts/setup-db.ts`); Vite `vite-base-template/`.

`npm run dev` (`http://localhost:3000`); `npm run build`; `npm run start`; `npm run lint`; `cd vite-base-template && npm run dev` (`:5173`); `npm --prefix vite-base-template run build`.

TypeScript strict, noEmit; `@/*` → `src/*`; Tailwind v4. No test runner; prefer Vitest/Jest + React Testing Library. PRs must include: summary/rationale, local test steps, UI screenshots, issues, build/lint/run checklist. use `.env.local` for developer machines; do not commit secrets. `NEXT_PUBLIC_*` client-exposed. Rotate leaked credentials promptly; prefer per-env keys. `/iframe/*` rewrites to `src/app/api/iframe`.
